findings.finding: All twenty A cards repeat the same null-fixture pointer and unspecified exact-identity sentence. Several nulls are random partitions/operators/ideals; they define a control distribution but do not identify an old-method specialization or the equality/certificate to reproduce. Identity transport, separable costs and invertible coordinate changes already suggest useful baseline slices in some cards, but the reproduction statement is still implicit.
findings.required_revision: For each card, name the exact baseline object/method, parameter slice, and expected equality or certificate checked before the proposed gain. If exact baseline embedding is inapplicable, provide a reasoned not_applicable statement and retain the null as a separate control. Preserve the existing mechanism and immutable predecessor.
findings.scope_limit: This is a common specification defect. It does not show that twenty mechanisms are false, duplicate or unpromising.

findings.finding: The nonidentity-multiplier triangle is said to admit no global path-independent section, but a zero section is compatible with scalar transports. The main quantifier instead concerns full fiber identifications; these are different statements.
findings.required_revision: State that the controlled object is a nonzero generating frame or a full fiber trivialization, and fix the ambiguity subgroup/quotient. Check that the designated nontrivial loop remains nontrivial in that quotient. Keep ordinary sections distinct.
findings.scope_limit: Control wording and object definition only; no isogeny reduction was assessed or disproved.

findings.finding: The design explicitly uses a finite product-Bernoulli generating function, while the baseline asserts exact second factorial moment lambda squared. That identity is Poisson-style; for independent Bernoulli marks the finite correction sum of squared probabilities remains. Comparing to squared mean can therefore label a null effect as clustering.
findings.required_revision: Choose a finite Bernoulli or Poisson/limiting null and state its exact moment normalization. Align H1, the reported ratio and factor-two rejection rule to that same null; require the exact null to pass before norm-value comparisons.
findings.scope_limit: Static inconsistency between stated definitions. No norm form, finite fixture or probability calculation was executed.

findings.finding: The mechanism asks that the union of chart base loci avoid the permitted domain, while the claim says every pair is covered by at least one chart and elsewhere asks for the common base locus. The union condition would demand every chart work everywhere and can reject the intended jointly complete cover.
findings.required_revision: Use the common intersection of chart failure loci for the stated forall-pair/exists-chart claim. Add an explicit positive control whose charts are each incomplete but collectively cover the domain, alongside the incomplete single-chart control.
findings.scope_limit: Internal specification consistency only; no polynomial identity or curve arithmetic verified.

per_id.assessment: History-conditioned kernels, fiber sizes and partial-translation controls give a substantive generic-simulability candidate. Random equal-size partitions do not by themselves specify an exact reproduction identity; freeze history grammar and comparison kernel.
Pair-versus-triple correlation collisions and translate invariance make the observable falsifiable. Freeze selected offsets before the finite family; no compressed reconstruction cost is established.

Transport work and the prime-to-N condition are retained. Identity transport is a plausible baseline but its expected cost/certificate equality must be written explicitly; primary Teske intake and choice of cost functional remain gates.

A separable synthetic cost and bilinear interaction provide a useful square control. State the exact zero mixed-difference baseline and freeze the chosen curve-dependent cost coordinate before extending to conductor effects.

Orbit multiplicity is separated from independent supply, preserving the prior weakened relation-collection boundary. Marginal-preserving nulls and duplicate-orbit controls are relevant; specify the baseline counting identity.

Informative quotient and invariant factors improve the observability question; equal dimension/density/nullity nulls avoid a trivial signal. Name the full-operator certificate baseline and distinguish characteristic from minimal polynomial.

Stationary mass and return correlations are distinct, with a closed-trap control. H1 still needs a quantitative mixing class and a precise approximation error before a contract; no cryptographic transfer or excess walk speedup follows.

Height-shell occupancy addresses the exact low-height coverage bottleneck and includes a reduction-kernel countercontrol. The test is presently on abstract lattices; global CM models and height constants remain prerequisites.

Pointed holonomy is a relevant bridge-interface candidate, but the known-false control must specify nonzero generating frames or full fiber trivialization: zero sections survive nonidentity scalar holonomy. State the ambiguity quotient explicitly.

Full versus partial torsion translates provide point-dependent data with all orbit costs charged. The pairing-question link is supporting only: no CM-family embedding census, self-pairing nondegeneracy or target-field cost comparison is supplied.

Saturation and common-graph completeness retain discarded boundary points and restrict the target to constants. The invertible-change baseline is identifiable; write its exact graded/computational equality rather than a generic null identity.

Predicate-module growth and loop consistency give a concrete preprocessing-retention object. Full advice, basis and connection data are charged; freeze the stable-dictionary baseline and the exact AT-squared comparison model.

Observable-collision witnesses address instrument resolution. This supports the findings workflow but does not select replicated EV records or produce KN-FIND promotion decisions; the rank/nullspace comparison needs an explicit baseline claim.

Full-column degree-fall certificates distinguish first, last and solving degree and keep Boolean and odd-prime models separate. The exact known equality to reproduce must be named; no proposed tiny example satisfies the DREG n-ladder.

Relative syzygy gluing includes the repeated-squaring width control and charges separator growth. Exact source-defined signature objects and the calibrated D>=6 baseline remain prerequisites; random coefficients are a null, not that baseline.

Branch strata and automorphism-conditioned controls make exceptional mass visible. The full-monodromy branch-point countercontrol is well chosen; freeze the baseline fiber-count identity and every exceptional-stratum definition.

Rank-conditioned stopping addresses dependent relation supply and rejects repeated-row pseudo-success. Specify the independent-row completion-cost baseline; G4-G6 inputs, linear algebra, descent and verification remain required.

The elliptic-addition transfer is explicitly missing, with conductor and exceptional mass retained. Constant-sheaf exclusion is meaningful; a same-conductor random null does not reproduce the source theorem. No multiplicative exponent transfers automatically.

Fitting-minor torsion gives a concrete characteristic-transfer obstruction with the diag(1,2) control. Freeze a primitive-minor rank-preservation identity and a common integral presentation; Boolean/prime transfer remains conditional.

Overlap compatibility distinguishes local compression from global consistency, with an odd-cycle control. Specify the exact consistent-atlas baseline and account for potentially exponential overlap width; no scalable solver claim.

Second moments distinguish total incidence mass from hit probability and concentration. Construction of incidences and witness discovery are charged separately; a bound from supplied tables is only a conditional success input.
The finite product-Bernoulli test conflicts with the lambda-squared exact baseline; revise the null normalization before interpreting the factor-two threshold or clustering signal.

Descent cocycles verify supplied transition maps and retain the cost of exact isomorphism checks. This is compatibility certification, with no unknown morphism or endomorphism-ring construction claimed.

Mixed differences test whether a complete switch table is additively integrable; missing vertices are a relevant control. Published figures, three-source filing, circuit gate counts and class-group calibration remain open.

Strong lumpability is a concrete sufficient condition and retry-state omission is controlled. Exact SQIsign v3 source abstraction and simulator correspondence are prerequisites; failure is not a failure of zero knowledge.

Typed compatibility diagrams distinguish decoded-object agreement from matching byte lengths. The added-component control is relevant, but a complete v3 published/internal inventory and actual template obstruction remain unestablished.

Named sections and specialization-loss controls support the exact-rank certificate question. Before design, write the common coefficient prime and stacked good-reduction quotient maps explicitly; a single finite fiber must not be mistaken for arbitrary-rank certification.

Division forests preserve rational span through certified identities and separate witness discovery from verification. A failed bounded forest gives no dependence conclusion and produces no automatic rank gain.

Joint ramification and squareclass dependence identify a cheap obstruction to stacked bisections; low genus and independent new sections are separately required. The proposed two-point fixture is not a rank-32 construction.

Weighted character support directly addresses field degree at fixed certified rank, with unmeasured weights zero and basis-change controls. Rank>=31 over degree<=8 remains literal; unknown ranks limit any optimum.

Dependency liveness and recomputation make reversible model translation explicit, including an erasure control. The claim is restricted to the named scheduling model, not a general circuit lower bound or CSIDH security estimate.

Integral norm witnesses separate invariant dimension from exhibited descent points and expose denominator/index loss. Anti-invariant vanishing is a useful control; no unexhibited division or rational rank-32 inference is accepted.

Joint curve/twist congruences use lcm rather than product and include ambiguous-survivor controls. All twenty applications require exact order/divisibility premises; trace uniqueness certifies only the stated order question.

Invariant factors and typed domains distinguish torsion annihilation from subgroup preservation. Group order alone cannot supply the required decomposition, and cofactor clearing is no general hardness certificate.

Total projective maps and inverse/degree certificates address chart exceptions. Ed448 isogeny versus birational models are correctly distinguished; extension and source premises remain per-model obligations.

The mechanism uses the union of base loci while its quantified claim requires their common intersection. Correct the certificate statement and test a collectively complete cover with individually incomplete charts.

First-acceptance prefix proofs retain every visited state and rejection witness. They establish relative reproducibility only; missing historical generation material for FRP/E-382 cannot be reconstructed from output parameters.

An implication/countermodel graph is substantive, with residue-class assumptions controlled. The cited internal Curve1174 record gives the exact starting relation; inline its domain exclusions and predicates in the future frozen contract.

Deterministic modular residual checking retains integer bounds and a 2B separation requirement. It verifies encoded arithmetic identities only; omitted premises and group-order truth are not supplied by residues.

Parameter strata and representation-invariance controls support sensitivity checking without assuming coefficient continuity or equal hardness. Anomalous and BN positive controls require exact sourced tuples, not inherited table flags.

Posterior-fiber compression addresses memory accounting for a supplied channel and controls marginal-only grouping. It supplies no nonce-recovery boundary, solver comparison or deployed-parameter frontier.

Conditional-history total-variation bounds retain dependence and exponential joint-table costs. These are model-robustness certificates for abstract channels; calibration and recovery experiments remain separate.

Residual-domain kernel intersection is a precise verification-refinement object. RFC8032 supports the selected equations; FIPS comparison, filed specification matrix and public-transcript reachability are not established.

Immutable transcript types and post-freeze randomness state useful batch-proof preconditions. Prime-order residual assumptions, hashing/decoding and coefficient quantifiers must remain explicit; no separating signatures or deployed claim is supplied.

Typed consuming-lemma preconditions give a defensive proof-coverage proposal. Exact named proof sets and source filing remain gates; this does not provide campaign extraction certificates, session curves or a verified fix map.

Public label supply and divisibility are separated as necessary conditions. This is a supporting input-contract check; no complete deployed-order factorization census, protocol inventory or per-curve optimum is supplied.

Storage counting exposes a matrix-representation assumption and includes structured-family countercontrol. It supplies no exTNFS polynomial selection or calibration, and uniform-matrix bounds do not automatically apply to actual matrices.

Dependent uncertainty propagation retains shared variables and crossing-frontier cases. It supports estimator sensitivity only; published-baseline reproduction, numerical calibration and global optimization costs remain open.
